summary: Specifies Verifiable Random Functions, a public-key version of a keyed hash. Only the secret key holder can compute the output, but anyone with the public key can check it. It gives RSA and elliptic-curve constructions. It is a product of the Crypto Forum Research Group.

eli5.summary: Only you can roll a special dice, but anyone can check that the roll was honest and could not have been picked on purpose.

questions: what is a verifiable random function
